sources.title: Minister curriculum vitae
sources.findings: Born July 4, 1984; Brown international relations BA and Harvard MBA; Gojek CEO 2010–2019; consulting 2006–2009.
sources.caution: Historical CV: current minister wording obsolete. Resignation chronology superseded by dated reporting. Award claims not adopted.

sources.title: September 2016 international alumni newsletter
sources.findings: Identifies Nadiem Makarim as class of 2006 and Gojek founder/CEO.
sources.caution: Historical role; no current CEO inference.

sources.title: Gojek at a glance
sources.findings: Company established 2010; app launched January 2015; transport, food delivery and logistics platform.
sources.caution: Corporate account; user/driver totals and social-impact claims not independently evaluated.

sources.title: October 21, 2019 profile and Gojek departure
sources.findings: Announced departure October 21, 2019; company confirmed new co-CEOs. MBA 2011 after starting 2009.
sources.caution: Contains errors: Brown located in England, Gojek founded 2011 and Nikkei prize 2018. These are not adopted; MBA year omitted pending stronger university evidence.

sources.title: Indonesia Maju cabinet roster
sources.findings: Education and Culture minister October 23, 2019–April 28, 2021; expanded title from April 28, 2021; cabinet term ends October 20, 2024.
sources.caution: Historic roster, dashes not current service.

sources.title: April 28, 2021 ministerial inauguration
sources.findings: Sworn in as Education, Culture, Research and Technology minister for remainder of 2019–2024 term.
sources.caution: BRIN leadership belongs to Laksana Tri Handoko, not Makarim.

sources.title: Merdeka Belajar episode one
sources.findings: First package launched December 11, 2019: school exams, national assessment, lesson plans and admissions zoning.
sources.caution: Retrospective ministry account; policy announcements not proof of learning gains.

sources.title: September 24, 2026 appeal and response
sources.findings: Appeal reduced Chromebook procurement corruption sentence from ten to nine years; Makarim denies wrongdoing and seeks cassation. Reported court appearance September 24.
sources.caution: Fine and restitution default imprisonment conditional; not summed into current primary sentence. Court judgment itself not accessed.

sources.title: October 19, 2026 cassation report
sources.findings: Lawyer says memorandum filed October 16, requesting Supreme Court quash appeal ruling and acquit.
sources.caution: Defense statement, not court disposition. Photo September 24, not October 19. Caption mislabels restitution as fine; do not adopt. No later Supreme Court result established.
